datasets.name: Google Earth images of Huizhou District, Huangshan City, Anhui Province
datasets.verbatim: The data used in the experiments were obtained from Google Earth images.

methods.name: L-Unet
methods.summary: L-Unet is an improved U-Net model for landslide extraction. It incorporates a multi-scale feature-fusion (MFF) module based on dilated convolution at the end of the encoding network, a residual attention network (combining residual blocks and CoordAttention) to deepen the network and focus on landslide features, and replaces bilinear interpolation with data-dependent upsampling (DUpsampling) in the decoding network.
methods.source: Zhangyu Dong, Sen An, Jin Zhang, Jinqiu Yu, Jinhui Li, and Daoli Xu
methods.verbatim: In order to solve the problems noted above, we improved the U-Net model and thus propose an automatic landslide extraction model named L-Unet.

availability.author_statement: The data presented in this study are available on request from the corresponding author.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom L-Unet code is not provided or linked.
